title: Hard to clean finish on one side
text: Hard to clean finish on one side. I bought this cheese board set to use in our RV.  I thought it would be nice to have everything compartmentalized.  It's nice for that, but when I tried to clean it with a cloth, one side was very rough and caught on the fabric.  I'm wondering if it is supposed to be that way or if this board wasn't finished.  My son in-law has one that is much smoother.  Is this just a natural occurance with wood boards?
